name: Cerise
source:
Sophie’s childhood friend. She’s kind and sweet, but incredibly shy, anxious and reclusive. Cerise is good at almost everything she tries, but takes all criticism to heart and doubts herself to the point of self-sabotage. Because of her knowledge of the occult, Sophie asked for her help in removing Colette’s curse.

Cerise is now helping out at the Resting Bean while trying to find a way to break the curse.
